Industrial spray painter (€20-€22 per hour) - Emmeloord region 
 New 
 What for you? 
 Apply immediately 
Earn €20 to €22 per hour as an industrial sprayer at one of our clients in the Emmeloord region. 
Are you an experienced industrial painter and do you enjoy working on high-quality products and structures? For our client, we are looking for skilled professionals who can work independently and value quality. 
Whether you already live in the Netherlands or want to come and work from abroad, we are happy to help you find a suitable job. What are you going to do? 
As an industrial sprayer, you are responsible for preparing, treating, and spraying a wide range of products and structures. You ensure that surfaces are finished neatly and meet the client's quality requirements. 
Your duties may include, among other things: - Surface pre-treatment - Sanding, degreasing and masking - Application of coatings and lacquer layers - Checking the quality of the spray painting - Maintaining tools and equipment - Working according to safety and quality guidelines What are we asking? - Demonstrable experience as an industrial sprayer - Independent and accurate work attitude - Technical insight and an eye for detail - Sufficient command of English or Dutch - A B driving license is a plus. What do we offer? - Salary of €20 to €22 gross per hour, depending on experience - Full-time work for a longer period - Opportunity for a permanent contract upon good performance - Working for professional and stable clients - Good guidance from Mondial Uitzend - Travel allowance where applicable 
Are you from abroad? Then we can provide support with: - Housing - Commuting to work - Guidance with working and living in the Netherlands Why work via Mondial Uitzend?
